Plot the distribution of pseudotime across clusters

PlotPseudotime.Rd

Engine-agnostic pseudotime panel: takes any numeric meta.data column, so the same function plots a Slingshot lineage ("Slingshot_Pseudotime_1"), a Monocle3 pseudotime ("Monocle3_Pseudotime"), or any other pseudotime-like column, without re-implementing the same density/ridge plotting code per method.

Produces a density + rug plot of pseudotime per group.by level, with peak labels, and optionally a ridge plot of the same values split/filled by a second variable (e.g. treatment response).

Usage

PlotPseudotime(
  seurat_object,
  pseudotime.by,
  group.by = NULL,
  split.by = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  split_colors = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  object_name = "",
  subset_name = "",
  file_name = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

seurat_object

A Seurat object.

pseudotime.by

Character. Numeric meta.data column holding a pseudotime value (e.g. from RunSlingshot).

group.by

Character or NULL. Cluster/cell-type column for color and the y-axis of the ridge plot. NULL (default) uses the cluster.by stored by RunSlingshot when present.

split.by

Character or NULL. Secondary variable (e.g. "Response", "Sample") used to fill the ridge plot. NULL (default) skips the ridge panel.

colors

Named color vector for group.by. NULL auto-resolves from PrepObject or Nour_pal.

split_colors

Named color vector for split.by. NULL auto-resolves the same way.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Directory to save a PDF. NULL (default) walks up to the output_dir stored by PrepObject (respecting AutoSavePlots); pass NA to suppress entirely.

object_name, subset_name

Character. Output file-name prefixes.

file_name

Character or NULL. Base name (no extension) for the saved PDF. NULL auto-deduces from pseudotime.by.

width, height

Numeric or NULL. Saved PDF dimensions in inches. NULL (default) auto-sizes to 1 or 2 panels.

Value

A patchwork (or single ggplot) object.
